<div class="section-intro">
Projects is the development layer of this website: work that is active or planned but is not yet represented by a formal publication. Private manuscript repositories can be described here without exposing their source repository; mature public outputs are surfaced under Publications, Software, or the appropriate final-product section.
</div>

::: {.qs-footnote-note}
**Project model.** `type-paper` is reserved for a repository tied to one scientific manuscript. Private `type-paper` work may appear here while it is under development, without a public repository link. `type-project` is reserved for a broader or exploratory research initiative that is not yet committed to one manuscript—for example an incubating collaboration, a multi-output research programme, or a project explicitly seeking collaborators. When a specific manuscript becomes defined, it should normally receive its own `*-paper` repository and `type-paper` classification. Public mature outputs are discovered through Publications, Software, or another final-product section rather than duplicated here.
:::
